mapper.sql: P.PRD_CD, P.PRD_NM, P.SELLER_ID, P.CTG_CD, P.SALE_PRC, P.SALE_STAT, NVL(P.RTN_FEE, 3000) AS RTN_FEE
mapper.select: SELECT P.PRD_CD, S.COMM_RATE AS SELLER_COMM_RATE, C.COMM_RATE AS CTG_COMM_RATE, UC.COMM_RATE AS UPPER_CTG_COMM_RATE FROM TB_PRD P JOIN TB_SELLER S ON S.SELLER_ID = P.SELLER_ID JOIN TB_PRD_CTG C ON C.CTG_CD = P.CTG_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_CTG UC ON UC.CTG_CD = C.UPPER_CTG_CD WHERE P.PRD_CD = #{prdCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRD (PRD_CD, PRD_NM, SELLER_ID, CTG_CD, SALE_PRC, SUPPLY_PRC, SALE_STAT, RTN_FEE, DLV_FEE_TYPE, MAX_ORD_QTY, REG_DT, REG_ID) VALUES (#{PRD_CD}, #{PRD_NM}, #{SELLER_ID}, #{CTG_CD}, #{SALE_PRC}, #{SUPPLY_PRC}, #{SALE_STAT}, #{RTN_FEE}, NVL(#{DLV_FEE_TYPE}, 'B'), #{MAX_ORD_QTY}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PRD SET PRD_NM = #{PRD_NM}, CTG_CD = #{CTG_CD}, SALE_PRC = #{SALE_PRC}, SUPPLY_PRC = #{SUPPLY_PRC}, SALE_STAT = #{SALE_STAT}, RTN_FEE = #{RTN_FEE}, DLV_FEE_TYPE = NVL(#{DLV_FEE_TYPE}, DLV_FEE_TYPE), MAX_ORD_QTY = #{MAX_ORD_QTY}, STOP_RSN = DECODE(#{SALE_STAT}, 'ON', NULL, NVL(#{STOP_RSN}, STOP_RSN)), UPD_ID = #{USER_ID}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PRD_CD = #{PRD_CD}
mapper.select: SELECT CTG_CD, CTG_NM, UPPER_CTG_CD, COMM_RATE, USE_YN FROM TB_PRD_CTG WHERE CTG_CD = #{ctgCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PRD_CTG WHERE UPPER_CTG_CD = #{ctgCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PRD WHERE CTG_CD = #{ctgCd}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_PRD_CTG T USING (SELECT #{CTG_CD} AS CTG_CD FROM DUAL) S ON (T.CTG_CD = S.CTG_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CTG_NM = #{CTG_NM}, UPPER_CTG_CD = #{UPPER_CTG_CD}, CTG_LVL = #{CTG_LVL}, COMM_RATE = #{COMM_RATE}, SORT_ORD = NVL(#{SORT_ORD}, 0), USE_YN = NVL(#{USE_YN}, 'Y'), UPD_ID = #{USER_ID}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CTG_CD, CTG_NM, UPPER_CTG_CD, CTG_LVL, COMM_RATE, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, REG_DT) VALUES (#{CTG_CD}, #{CTG_NM}, #{UPPER_CTG_CD}, #{CTG_LVL}, #{COMM_RATE}, NVL(#{SORT_ORD}, 0), NVL(#{USE_YN}, 'Y'), SYSDATE)

UPDATE TB_SELLER SET SELLER_STAT = #{SELLER_STAT}, STOP_RSN = DECODE(#{SELLER_STAT}, 'A', NULL, #{STOP_RSN}), STOP_DT = DECODE(#{SELLER_STAT}, 'A', NULL, SYSDATE), UPD_ID = #{USER_ID}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE SELLER_ID = #{SELLER_ID}
UPDATE TB_PRD SET SALE_STAT = 'STOP', STOP_RSN = #{STOP_RSN}, UPD_ID = #{USER_ID}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE SELLER_ID = #{SELLER_ID} AND SALE_STAT = 'ON'
